data.name: Sorceress Services
data.detailed_description:
As adventurers, treasure-seekers, and mercenaries roam the world, all of them seek one thing before their next journey: a place where their gear can be enchanted.

Some find their way to the peaceful kingdom of Magnolia, where magic is slowly being woven into daily life.

You are a newly accredited Sorceress, seizing the chance to open your own shop. Customers arrive not only with coin, but with proof of their Rank - and sometimes with personal requests you may choose to fulfill.

Some simply want new gear. Others demand enchantments far beyond their station. Each will test your patience, morality, and persuasion. It is your duty to balance their desires with Magnolia’s strict magical regulations in order to keep your reputation intact.

FEATURES

  • Narrative-driven choices – Encounter unique characters with their own stories, and shape the paths they take.

  • Persuasion & negotiation – Use wit, charm, and clever tactics to haggle, calm stubborn clients, or inspire loyalty.

  • Gesture-based casting – Enchant gear and items by performing spell patterns with your own hands.

  • Reputation system – Grow your influence from a small-town shop to renown across the land.

Magnolia watches your every move. Yet, there are many who need your magic.
How will your choices shape your world?

data.short_description: Starting anew as a rookie Sorceress, complete magical transactions and requests to build your clientele and grow your business! In this narrative-driven fantasy vendor simulator, follow unique quest lines, use persuasive techniques, and cast enchantments on your goods with gestures.
